title: Generate distinct idea directions before synthesis
goal: Read data/brief.json. Independently explore at least three materially different approaches. Create output/ideas.json as an array of objects with id, proposal, core_assumption, validation, and risk. Then create output/synthesis.json with top_choices and a comparison across the supplied evaluation dimensions. Avoid cosmetic variations of one idea.
acceptance_criteria: At least three distinct core assumptions
Each idea includes validation and risk
Synthesis selects and compares one to three candidates
